# Heist (heistbrain.com)
> Heist is a content planner and social media scheduler for small businesses, consultants and creators. It keeps your brand voice on file, works with the AI you already use (Claude, ChatGPT or your own API key) to plan and draft a month of social posts, and puts every draft through your review before anything is scheduled.

Last verified: 2026-11-27. Prices and plan limits were last checked against the app and Stripe on 2026-11-22.

## Key facts
- Name: Heist. Website: https://heistbrain.com. App: https://app.heistbrain.com. "Heistbrain" is the domain, not a different product.
- Category: content planner and social media scheduler (web app).
- How the AI works: Heist does not charge a separate AI-generation fee and does not run hosted AI for you. You either connect your AI chat (Claude or ChatGPT, over MCP) or add your own AI API key. Your AI provider's plan, limits and any usage charges apply.
- Connecting your AI chat (MCP connector): included on Pro, Founder, Agency and the 7-day trial. Claude's custom connector works on any Claude plan, including Free. ChatGPT needs a paid plan with developer mode turned on. Starter does not include the connector and writes with your own AI API key.
- Review first: drafts land in Heist for you to review and approve. Nothing posts without your approval unless you turn on Autopilot yourself.
- Publishing: connects to LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and WordPress, plus a hosted website blog. X works through your own X developer app keys on a paid X API tier. TikTok, Pinterest and Reddit are coming soon.
- Pricing (monthly): Starter $19, Pro $49, Founder $99, Agency $199. Billed yearly: $192, $492, $984 and $1,908 a year (about two months free).
- Limits: Starter 1 brand and 100 posts a month; Pro 1 brand and 500 posts a month; Founder 5 brands, 3 team seats, unlimited posts; Agency 25 brands, 10 team seats, unlimited posts. Founder and Agency include content approvals and roles.
- Free trial: 7 days of Pro, no credit card. When it ends the account locks until you choose a plan; your data is kept and you can still sign in to download it or delete the account.
- Not available yet: the personalized visual Planner, TikTok/Pinterest/Reddit publishing.
- Contact: support@heistbrain.com
